method: Exact semantic projection, not a new scientific audit. Policy strings use all lexicographic base-6 histories at a fixed depth. Each row dictionary is an exact 63-coordinate vector: map nonzero rational strings to inclusive mask ranges, with every unlisted mask equal to zero. Every multiplier occurrence retains its query, source order and exact coefficient. Repeated row values are displayed once, with all uses retained.
scope: Each fixed complete policy cone only; arbitrary nonnegative customer-type weights and all safety distributions
